generation: Codex built-in image_gen; no API key
editable_source: OpenRaster .ora for Krita; native .aseprite with timeline cels
segmentation_usage: Install the pinned optional package in a disposable Python environment for build_bridge_front_rail.py and build_arrival_bough_source.py. No OpenCV dependency in the game; no ignored machine-local input files are required.

steps: Copy grass/review-atlas.png to assets/sprites/sky_lagoon/animated_v1/grass_breeze.png (640x640, lossless import; no VRAM compression).
Export bridge/bridge-planks-v3.aseprite as bridge/planks-full-atlas.png and .json, 4 columns
Export bellflower/bellflower-eight-cels.aseprite as bellflower/bellflower-atlas.png and .json, 4 columns
Set SKY_MASTER_EXPORT to a disposable absolute directory; run Godot 4.7.2 headless -s scripts/probe_sky_lagoon_export_layers.gd

invocation.python: Run python -B <package>/<builder>.py from the repository root. Use UTF-8 mode on Windows.
invocation.source_authority: Packaged generated sources are immutable inputs. Rebuilding does not call an image-generation API. Re-generation is not deterministic and is not part of the rebuild.

historical_trials: build_bridge_contact.lua and build_bridge_source.lua preserve earlier trials; they are not the accepted runtime rebuild path.
rebuild_verification: Isolated-copy rebuild on this pinned local toolchain passed: 16 derived runtime PNGs pixel-identical, including bridge, chains, grass, plants, boughs, both water accents and mask. See evidence/source-rebuild.json. Static cloud/shared ripple and fresh-machine dependency installation excluded. ORA/Aseprite container bytes need not match.
preserved_static_inputs: cloud_painted.png: reproduce the source component/crop in CLOUD_REUSE.json; preserve its connected-component alpha, not the surrounding clouds.

Water tap ring: reuse the existing shared runtime atlas identified by scripts/arena/sky_lagoon_water_cels.gd; build_water_source.lua takes its absolute path as --script-param atlas=<path> and creates the editable eight-cel timeline.
